History.title: Sheet history

Settings.title: Personal details
Settings.subtitle: These details are printed on every OT sheet.
Settings.signatureHint: Sign in the box with your finger or mouse, or upload a photo of your signature. It is printed in the signature (ސޮއި) columns of your sheets.
Settings.signatureNotSaved: Details saved, but the signature could not be stored yet (database update pending).
Settings.cropHint: Drag to move. Pinch, scroll or use the slider to zoom.

Reminder.title: Monthly reminder
Reminder.hint: Get a notification on the 15th of every month to submit your OT sheet.
Reminder.needsInstall: On iPhone, first add this app to your Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen), then open it from there to turn on reminders.
Reminder.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings to turn on reminders.
Reminder.banner: Reminder: please submit your OT sheet.
Reminder.testSent: Sent! It should appear in a few seconds.
Reminder.testNotRegistered: This device isn't registered. Turn the reminder off and on again.
Reminder.notConfigured: Reminders aren't switched on for this site yet. Please ask the app admin.

Install.title: Install the app
Install.cardHint: Add Hamad OT to your home screen. It opens full-screen like a normal app, and on iPhone it's needed for reminders.
Install.bannerHint: Open it from your home screen like a normal app.
Install.iosIntro: Do this in Safari on your iPhone or iPad.
Install.androidIntro: Do this in Chrome on your Android phone.
Install.ios1Hint: At the bottom of Safari (top on iPad). On newer iPhones, tap ••• first, then Share.
Install.ios2Hint: Scroll down the list if you don't see it.
Install.ios3Hint: Top-right corner. You can keep the name “Hamad OT”.
Install.android2: Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”
Install.android2Hint: The wording depends on your phone.
Install.done: Open Hamad OT from your home screen
Install.doneHint: Look for the school crest icon.
